question: What is the mode of the following data? 87, 65, 70, 81, 68, 62, 82, 78, 81, 82, 74, 75, 90, 67, 86, 86, 81, 90, 69, 78, 65, 78, 76, 63, 70, 81
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In any given dataset, the mode is simply the number that appears the maximum number of times.

By visually scanning the data, we can count the frequency of the most repeating numbers.

Number 81 appears 4 times, 78 appears 3 times, and 65, 70, 82, 86, and 90 appear 2 times.

Since 81 has the highest frequency, it is the mode.

**∴ The correct answer is 81.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Data: 87, 65, 70, 81, 68, 62, 82, 78, 81, 82, 74, 75, 90, 67, 86, 86, 81, 90, 69, 78, 65, 78, 76, 63, 70, 81

**Formula Used:**

Mode = The observation with the highest frequency in a given set of data.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let us note the distinct elements and count their occurrences (frequencies) in the dataset:

⇒ Frequency of 81 = 4

⇒ Frequency of 78 = 3

⇒ Frequency of 65, 70, 82, 86, and 90 = 2 (each)

⇒ Frequency of 62, 63, 67, 68, 69, 74, 75, 76, and 87 = 1 (each)

⇒ The highest frequency is 4, which corresponds to the observation 81.

**∴ The correct answer is 81.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean

The mean is the average of all observations, calculated by dividing the sum of all values by the total number of values.

Median

The median is the middlemost value of a dataset when arranged in ascending or descending order. For an even number of observations, it is the average of the two middle values.

Mode Types

A dataset can be unimodal (one mode), bimodal (two modes), or multimodal (more than two modes) depending on how many distinct values share the highest frequency.

Empirical Relationship

For a moderately skewed distribution, the statistical relationship between mean, median, and mode is given by: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.
